name: Smileys Field
description: provides a field for selecting smileys/emoji.
project_description:
This is a modern version of Drupal 6 Smileys module

 Body fields with CKEditor 5 don't support now! 

 Smileys is a text filter that substitutes ASCII smileys/smilies/emoticons with images.

 This is a simple smiley-filter that allows the easy use of graphical smileys (or 'emoticons') on a Drupal site. It comes with a set of example smileys. An unlimited amount of custom smileys can be setup as well.

 Drupal 10+ version additional features: 

 
 Smileys field is a pseudo field. You can add it before your body field 
 Migrations from Drupal 6 
 Emoji support
